text:
rachel: Quick copy pass for the rate-limit infobar that appears when users hit a per-route token cap. Current copy: "Rate limit reached" + small link "Learn more". Feels terse and a bit scary.

chris: Agree. We should tell users what happened, how long they'll be blocked (if known), and a next step. Keep it a single short sentence.

jin: Proposed short variants:
- "You've hit the route token limit. Retry in 1 minute or adjust quota."
- "This route is rate-limited. Try again in a minute or edit settings."
Both are similar; prefer "Try again" over "Retry"?

om: Mobile space is tight. Keep to ~50 chars if possible. Also the infobar CTA should be one action (primary) not a link cluster. Maybe a button "Request higher quota" and a small secondary link "Docs".

pear: Accessibility: infobar should be role=alert with aria-live=assertive so screen readers announce it immediately. For the CTA, use aria-label that includes the route name: "Request higher quota for route X". Also include a visually-hidden sentence with the time remaining if we can estimate.

rachel: Draft compact copy (visual):
"This route is rate-limited. Try again in 1 minute or request a higher quota."
Primary CTA: "Request higher quota" (opens modal)
Secondary link: "Docs: rate limits" -> /docs/rate-limits

chris: Tiny wording nit: "Try again in 1 minute" might be wrong for glass windows where we don't have ETA. If we don't have a reliable ETA, use "Try again shortly". If we do have a countdown, show "Try again in 01:00".

jin: Suggest logic: show exact countdown if remaining_time <= 5 minutes else show "Try again shortly". That keeps copy accurate. Also change phrasing to active voice: "You've used your tokens for this route. Try again in..." but that's longer. Keep short.

om: For the modal that opens from the CTA, copy should include steps to get quota: contact support or apply via UI. Example modal header: "Request temporary quota increase" with bullet: "Estimated turnaround: 1 business day". Keep that separate from toast.

pear: Accessibility handoff for the infobar:
- infobar role=alert, aria-live=assertive
- visible text: "This route is rate-limited. Try again shortly or request a higher quota."
- CTA aria-label: "Request higher quota for [route name]"
- if showing countdown, expose visually-hidden text: "Time until reset: 1 minute" with id that CTA aria-describedby points to when appropriate

rachel: Final visual copy for handoff (short):
Infobar text: "This route is rate-limited. Try again shortly or request a higher quota."
Primary CTA (visual): "Request higher quota"
Primary CTA aria-label: "Request higher quota for [route name]"
Secondary link: "Docs: rate limits" -> /docs/rate-limits
Countdown rule: show exact time when <= 5 minutes else show "Try again shortly"

chris: LGTM. For translations avoid embedding numbers into translatable strings for the countdown; use separate token.

jin: I'll add the copy + aria notes to the PR and include the countdown logic comments.
